messages.content: You are the corporate HR AI assistant.
When does health insurance coverage become effective for new hires?
Health insurance benefits become effective on the first calendar day of the month following the employee's official start date.
You are the corporate IT compliance bot.
Can I install third-party software on my company laptop without approval?
No, all software installations must be pre-approved by the IT Security Team and installed via the Self-Service Software Portal or by IT administrator dispatch.
You are the legal affairs assistant.
Who is authorized to sign NDAs on behalf of the company?
Only officers of the company at the Vice President level or above, or authorized signatories designated by the Legal Department in writing, may execute non-disclosure agreements.
